hypothesis: Transcription factor overexpression can reverse cellular differentiation without egg cytoplasm
prediction: The number of cells that regain pluripotency markers when treated with the four factors (Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, c-Myc) will be significantly higher than untreated differentiated cells
measurement_method: Flow cytometry to quantify percentage of cells expressing pluripotency markers (e.g., Oct4, Nanog) after 7 days of factor exposure
falsification_condition: Observed percentage of pluripotent marker-positive cells in treated group is not significantly higher than untreated control (p > 0.05)
